source.text: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) (both squamous and non-squamous).
locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.
Participants must have at least 1 lesion that meets the definition of measurable disease by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1 criteria
Symptomatic central nervous system (CNS) metastases must have been treated, be asymptomatic for ≥14 days
No concurrent leptomeningeal disease or cord compression.
Diagnosed with a second primary invasive malignancy not in remission for ≥3 years.
History of a bone marrow transplantation within the past 5 years or solid organ transplantation (as a recipient) and use of immunosuppressive agents.
Has a positive serum pregnancy test during the screening period or a positive urine pregnancy test on Day 1 before the first dose of trial intervention.
Confirmed PD-L1 positive by an FDA approved, Conformité Européene (CE)-marked, or other health-authority equivalent test in local lab.
